parameters.name: Code
parameters.description: The code of the configuration item in the anomaly alert general configuration module. You can call [DescribeConfigs](~~DescribeConfigs~~) to obtain the Code of the configuration item.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:
- **zh_cn**: Chinese. This is the default value.
- **en_us**: English.
